metadata.fiscalCycle: CY 2026 Adopted Municipal Budget & User-Friendly Budget
metadata.sourceAgency: NJ Department of Community Affairs (DLGS) & Township of Parsippany-Troy Hills Finance Department

revenueSources.source: Local Property Tax for Municipal & Library Purposes
revenueSources.description: Portion paid on quarterly property tax bills by Parsippany homeowners and commercial properties

revenueSources.source: PILOT Service Charges & Hotel/Motel Occupancy Fees
revenueSources.description: Annual service charges from corporate/residential PILOT redevelopment agreements (Campus Dr, Route 10, Lanidex) plus hotel occupancy taxes
Direct state formula aid distributed by NJ Department of Community Affairs

revenueSources.source: Local Fees, Permits, Municipal Court & Interest
revenueSources.description: UCC building permits on new redevelopments, court fines, health licenses, and investment interest
Audited fund balance reserves and interfund operating transfers

majorAppropriations.details: Salaries for ~105+ sworn police officers (Patrol, Investigative Division, Traffic Safety, Community Relations), 911 dispatchers, police cruisers, and tactical gear.

majorAppropriations.category: Employee Group Health Insurance & Risk Management
majorAppropriations.details: Medical, prescription, and dental coverage for active township employees and retirees, plus Morris County Joint Insurance Fund (JIF) liability coverage.

majorAppropriations.category: Department of Public Works (Streets, Sanitation, Recycling & Parks)
majorAppropriations.details: Road maintenance across 200+ township road miles, municipal sanitation & recycling pickup, snow plowing, forestry, and maintenance of Smith Field, Veterans Park, and Knoll Park.
Mandatory employer pension contributions to Police & Firemen's Retirement System (PFRS) and Public Employees' Retirement System (PERS).
Principal and interest payments on general capital improvement bonds, road reconstruction, and open space acquisitions.

majorAppropriations.category: General Government, Finance, Tax Assessment & Legal
majorAppropriations.details: Mayor's Office, Township Council, Business Administrator, Township Clerk, CFO, Tax Assessor (commercial appeal defense), and Township Attorney.

majorAppropriations.category: Parsippany Public Library System (Main, Lake Hiawatha, Mount Tabor)
majorAppropriations.details: Mandatory 1/3 mill library appropriation funding the Main Library on Halsey Rd, Lake Hiawatha Branch, and historic Mount Tabor Branch.

majorAppropriations.category: 6 Independent Fire Districts Tax Levies (Billed on Property Tax Roll)
majorAppropriations.details: Parsippany operates 6 separate voter-elected Fire Districts (Districts 1 through 6), each levying its own dedicated fire tax ($0.072 to $0.135 per $100 assessed) for apparatus, stations, and volunteer/career fire protection.

majorAppropriations.category: Dedicated Water, Sewer & Knoll Golf Utilities (Self-Liquidating Enterprise Budgets)
majorAppropriations.details: Billed separately from property taxes: Parsippany Water Utility (~$14.2M), Sewer Utility (~$18.5M), and Knoll Country Club Golf Utility (~$3.1M).
